about.heading: Working in technical office, building my skills in BIM
paragraphs: I'm a Mechanical Power Engineer (B.Eng., Tanta University, 2024). Since February 2026 I've worked as a Site Technical Office Engineer at ARBEC, on infrastructure projects that include sewage lift stations, artificial lakes, and their drainage and firefighting networks.

On site I prepare mechanical shop drawings, material submittals, MIRs and IRs for consultant approval, calculate quantities, and follow installation and testing. I bring that experience with shop drawings, quantity take-off and approvals to BIM modeling and coordination work.

Alongside my job, I'm training in MEP BIM: modeling HVAC, fire fighting and plumbing systems in Revit MEP, coordinating them, and producing sheets and quantity schedules. Two MEP design diplomas back that up.

work.title: Site Technical Office Engineer (Mechanical)
work.context: Infrastructure projects: 4 sewage lift stations and 2 artificial lakes, including drainage and firefighting networks.
bullets: Prepare and update mechanical shop drawings for infrastructure and firefighting systems, and submit them for consultant approval.
Prepare and submit material submittals, MIRs and IRs to the consultant.
Calculate material quantities and manage purchase orders and site supplies.
Supervise installation and testing of drainage and firefighting networks and pumps.
Coordinate between the site team, management, consultant and employer, and prepare payment certificates for subcontractors and the employer.
